2609.17227.title: FROD: Feature Matching Residual Denoising Oracle Bone Decipher
2609.17227.paper_summary: Oracle bone script (OBS), one of the earliest Chinese writing systems, plays an important role in the study of Chinese etymology. Traditional decipherment relies heavily on domain experts who analyze characters through semantic context and structural evolution. To assist this labor-intensive process, we formulate OBS decipherment assistance as a cross-era image translation task and propose FROD (Feature Matching Residual Denoising Oracle Bone Decipher). Although many OBS characters differ substantially from their modern counterparts, they often preserve local topological invariants at the radical level. During training, FROD leverages fast feature matching to provide gated segmentation supervision: paired samples with sufficient matches are processed patch-wise to align fine-grained radicals, whereas low-similarity pairs are trained holistically to avoid mismatched artifacts. In addition, a Residual Denoising Diffusion Model (RDDM) jointly estimates noise and residual signals, thereby reducing the positional drift and stroke disorder commonly observed in standard diffusion models. Finally, a multi-stage font stylization refinement network refines the generated images by eliminating edge noise and stabilizing stroke structures. On our augmented character-disjoint dataset, FROD achieves higher Top-1 recognition accuracy than the evaluated baselines, with a 3.8% absolute gain over OBSD.
2609.17227.paper_summary_zh: 甲骨文 (OBS) 是最早的中文書寫系統之一，在中文詞源學的研究中扮演著重要角色。傳統的破譯工作在很大程度上依賴於領域專家，他們通過語義上下文和結構演變來分析字符。為了協助這一勞動密集型過程，我們將 OBS 破譯輔助公式化為一項跨時代的圖像翻譯任務，並提出 FROD（特徵匹配殘差去噪甲骨文破譯）。儘管許多 OBS 字符與其現代對應字符有顯著差異，但它們通常在部首層面上保留了局部拓撲不變性。在訓練過程中，FROD 利用快速特徵匹配提供門控分割監督：具有足夠匹配的配對樣本按補丁方式處理，以對齊細粒度的部首，而低相似度的配對則進行整體訓練，以避免不匹配的工件。此外，殘差去噪擴散模型 (RDDM) 共同估計噪聲和殘差信號，從而減少標準擴散模型中常見的位移漂移和筆劃紊亂。最後，多階段字體風格化精煉網絡通過消除邊緣噪聲和穩定筆劃結構來精煉生成的圖像。在我們增強的字符不重疊數據集上，FROD 的 Top-1 識別準確率超過了評估基準，較 OBSD 提高了 3.8% 的絕對增益。
